scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic. Numerical and exact finite checks supplement it. Related spectral-gap boundary is explicitly attributed to earlier work. Priority beyond inspected sources is unresolved. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for K_{m,m}, m>=3, two uniform positive edge-price classes, a perfect matching, independent nonnegative symmetric continuous-time rates, and fixed cost budget. Disconnected allocations allowed. Shortest-horizon transition admits disconnected support. No assertion for arbitrary cost matrices or imbalanced bicliques; finite checks are not infinite proof.
title: A hard price ceiling and three activation-time scales for matched bipartite diffusion
